input: I earn R$ 2,000 a month and the essentials (rent, food, transport) take R$ 1,700. Should I apply the 50/30/20 rule?

checks.description: Calculates that the essentials are 85% of income
Explains that above 70% the rule stops being useful
Points to the structural problem (fixed costs or income)
Says that 50/30/20 does not fit this case
Does not tell them to apply the rule as it is
